name: LicenseCustomer
description:
The customer a license is issued to, carried as a value inside the license.

 A self-hosting customer need not hold a cloud organization, so the license
 names its customer directly and links to an organization only when one
 exists. The customer is never a resource the license depends on: deleting
 an organization does not touch a license issued to its company.

fields.name: Id
fields.description:
Identifier the issuer minted for this customer, stable across every
 license issued to them.

fields.name: DisplayName
fields.description: The customer's name as the licensed server shows it ("licensed to Acme").

fields.name: ContactEmail
fields.description: The address renewal and expiry notices go to.

fields.name: Organization
fields.description:
The cloud organization this customer also holds, as its slug (the same
 value a resource's metadata.org carries). Empty when the customer has
 none.
